Common side effects include sensations such as tingling, warmth, pressure, or heaviness, as well as chest tightness or pressure [1]. More serious cardiovascular side effects, such as chest pain, heart attack, or stroke, have been reported, particularly in individuals with pre-existing cardiovascular conditions [2]. In summary, sumatriptan (Imitrex) is an effective treatment for acute migraine attacks, particularly when administered via nasal spray or subcutaneous injection. It works by constricting blood vessels in the brain and reducing inflammation, thereby alleviating migraine symptoms.
